messages:
rachel: Heads up — noticed a quality regression on mixtral-8b after deploying the new kernel-path ablation yesterday. Internal QA F1 on the QA suite dropped ~6 points. 😬

sunil: which rollout / change are we suspecting?

rachel: rollout #69 — the kernel selector now prefers tiled-attn for sequences <= 512 to reduce memory spikes. Deployed ~03:10 UTC. Before: F1 0.78, After: F1 0.72 on the same eval prompts.

emily: I grabbed a perf trace during generation. KV cache miss rate jumps during warmup and memcpy time is much higher on the candidate.

emily: ```
# perf top (candidate)
attn_kernel_tiled 45%
attn_kernel_unfused 10%
memcpy 25%
KVcache_lookup 8%
```

marco: hmm — tiled path was compiled with the quantized kernels and we set `rope_scale=true` in that build. Could be a RoPE scaling mismatch vs the unfused path.

sunil: confirmed — the tiled/quant path uses rope_scale=1.0 by default, baseline unfused path used 0.9998 for numerical parity. That tiny difference can push token logits enough to change QA spans.

rachel: I ran a local delta test: switch the tiled kernel to `rope_scale=0.9998` and candidate F1 returns to ~0.779. So it's definitely correlated.

ci-bot: quick-eval summary (on canary): 1000 samples. baseline F1=0.780; candidate F1=0.720; candidate+rope_scale_fix F1=0.779.

rachel: proposal: rollback rollout 69 immediately, and open a fix PR to align tiled kernel rope defaults with legacy kernels. Also add a canary-eval gate that checks QA F1 within ±0.01 before global rollout. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

sunil: +1 to rollback. Also we should add a KV-cache warmup metric to Console and alert if memcpy > 20% of CPU time in first 100 tokens — that would have flagged this earlier.

emily: I'll prepare rollback and the PR. Will include a unit/integration test asserting `rope_scale` parity for Mixtral/Llama configs and a short eval harness.

marco: filing an incident doc and tagging postmortem. We should also add an automatic check: if kernel-selector path changes for a model, run a smoke eval against the model's golden prompt set.

ops-bot: scheduled rollback of rollout 69 at 1955550180 by emily 

rachel: thanks team. After rollback lands, let's keep this thread for postmortem notes and follow-ups. Also add a note to the release checklist to include `rope_scale` parity checks when enabling quant/tiling kernels.
